title: Tag Claude In Your Team Chat — and It Ships the PR
description:
Tag Claude into your team chat and it works like a teammate: it follows the thread, finds the right place in the codebase, opens the pull request, and lands the change.

It works because access is scoped per channel — in engineering it can edit code; in legal it can only see the contracts. It literally cannot touch what it can't see. Memory respects the same lines, and it runs on its own account with its own credentials. Anthropic says 65% of its product-team code is now created this way.

Add Claude to one channel, tag it in, and watch.

#ClaudeTag #Claude #Anthropic #AIagents #DevTools
